title: Luxuriant Italian Olive Oil Focaccia
description: This luxurious Italian dish features a resinous and glassy-jelly texture, topped with kosher salt and flamed to perfection, making it a show-stopping focaccia.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, kosher salt, and active dry yeast.
Gradually add the olive oil and water to the dry ingredients, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a round or oblong focaccia.
Dimple the focaccia with your fingers and sprinkle with chopped rosemary leaves and garlic powder.
Drizzle the focaccia with olive oil and sprinkle with shaved grana padano cheese.
Flame the focaccia with a kitchen torch to create a glassy-jelly texture.
Bake the focaccia in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until it is golden brown.
